C0_DEPLOYED.definition: exact deployed 6x3 PICK_BASE inherited from V2 freeze

C3_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE.alpha_selection: development-only leave-one-draft-year-out macro MAE; choose smallest alpha within 1% relative MAE of the best to favor less shrinkage when statistically tied
C3_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE.deep_round_rule: R5-R6 are estimated only from their frozen depth-eligible catalogs and are smoothed jointly across adjacent exact slots by PAVA after shrinkage.
C3_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE.definition: Fit C2 on development data; compute year-balanced development O2 means for exact slots; shrink each slot mean toward its C2 slot prediction using alpha pseudo-drafts; enforce non-increasing slot values with weighted PAVA; aggregate slots 1-4,5-8,9-12 within each round to the production 18-cell schema.

C4_RAW_SLOT_ISOTONIC_DIAGNOSTIC.definition: year-balanced raw exact-slot O2 means followed by weighted PAVA with no shrinkage; diagnostic only because deep-slot effective N is lower

draft_harvest_contract.allowed_purpose: draft slot and identity resolution only

pick_rules.duplicate_player_within_same_league: exclude duplicate occurrence and flag source anomaly
pick_rules.slot: round-major actual pick order; slots 1-72 for 12-team six-round mapping

fit_weighting.league_market_weight: Each draft class contributes equal total weight. Within class and eligible depth, leagues are equally weighted.
fit_weighting.player_clustering: Outcome loss and uncertainty must collapse/cluster repeated selections by stable player identity within draft class before computing inferential uncertainty.
fit_weighting.player_outcome_independence: Repeated league selections of the same player are not independent outcome observations.

forbidden: KTC/current market values as fit targets
production changes from catalog, harvest, fit, or validation workflows

format_sensitivity.idp: IDP-format draft rows never enter primary R5-R6 fitting. Report IDP deep-round sensitivity separately. R1-R4 must also report non-IDP-only sensitivity against the accepted all-nonmock primary catalog.

frozen_scope_by_depth.deep_round_constraint: R5-R6 require pooled shrinkage/smoothing across adjacent slots and years; no unsmoothed per-year deep-slot production curve is eligible.
frozen_scope_by_depth.round_5: Primary inference uses primary_r5 non-IDP catalog; IDP rows are sensitivity only.
frozen_scope_by_depth.round_6: Primary inference uses primary_r6 non-IDP catalog; IDP rows are sensitivity only.
frozen_scope_by_depth.rounds_1_4: Use the accepted pooled-design primary_r1_r4 catalog exactly as frozen. IDP-format sensitivity is reported separately.
frozen_scope_by_depth.year_weighting: Each draft class receives total weight 1/6. Within a year, each eligible league in the relevant depth scope receives equal share of that year's weight.

historical_outcome_contract.availability_gate: Each primary class must have nonempty outcome data for draft_year through draft_year+2. Missing required seasons exclude the class before the development/validation split; all feasibility gates are then rechecked.
historical_outcome_contract.scoring_source: Current reviewed league scoring logic from research/roster-economics/historical_weekly_points_pipeline.py

identity_resolution.ambiguous_name_match: exclude and report; never choose manually after outcomes are visible
identity_resolution.coverage_denominator: unique drafted player identities in the eligible harvested catalog
identity_resolution.name_position_source: season-appropriate MFL player metadata may be used only for identity resolution
stable_identity_priority: unambiguous normalized name + position + draft class

O1_shape.definition: Score the rookie's first three NFL seasons under league scoring. Replacement PPG is full-NFL season PPG at the frozen positional rank among players with at least 3 games. Annual surplus=max(0, season_total - replacement_ppg*scheduled_games). Sum years 1-3.
O1_shape.name: three_year_replacement_adjusted_football_utility
O1_shape.use: shape robustness only; raw O1 is not FV

O2_scale.aggregation: arithmetic mean of years 1-3 annual FV equivalents
O2_scale.name: three_year_player_equivalent_fv

question: Using real historical 12-team Superflex/2QB rookie drafts, do realized first-three-season football outcomes support a more accurate absolute scale and round/tier shape for Draft Pick Fundamental Values than the deployed baseline?

reason_for_v3.change: V3 uses validated real MFL 12-team SF/2QB rookie drafts and actual draft slots instead of broad external archive rookie ADP. The football outcome definition and scale bridge are inherited from the preregistered V2 contract.

robustness.H4: first four NFL seasons where fully mature
robustness.idp_deep_round: required sensitivity report, never primary fit

eligibility_gates: validation macro MAE improvement vs C0 >= 5%
candidate must improve O2 macro MAE vs C0 in BOTH 2022 and 2023 validation classes
O1 normalized-shape error regression vs C0 <= 2%
H2 O2 macro-MAE regression vs candidate primary horizon <= 2% relative to its H3 standing
mature H4 O2 macro-MAE regression vs candidate primary horizon <= 2% relative to its H3 standing
18 production cells monotone non-increasing with later draft slot
no forbidden data read before locked validation scoring
selection.primary_metric: locked-validation equal-cell macro MAE on O2 three_year_player_equivalent_fv
selection.winner_rule: Lowest locked-validation O2 macro MAE among eligible candidates; if within 1% relative MAE choose the candidate with fewer effective fitted degrees of freedom in order C1, C2, C3.

source_population.2018_formal_boundary_note: The historical source-feasibility record remains a 24/25 transport-limited near-pass. V3 does not retroactively relabel that old gate.
source_population.dynasty_rule: keeperType=dynasty OR missing keeperType under the separately validated historical dynasty proxy

stage_gates.after_draft_harvest: Validate catalog counts, exact slot completeness, duplicate anomalies, and >=95% identity resolution. If these fail, stop before outcomes.
stage_gates.after_fit: Score locked 2022-2023 validation exactly once under the frozen candidate/selection rules.
stage_gates.after_identity_gate_passes: Historical outcomes may be ingested under the frozen provider/scoring contract.
stage_gates.after_selection: Freeze results. Production remains unchanged until a separate confirmation workflow.
stage_gates.after_this_freeze: Harvest exact draft picks and source identities only. Do not read historical NFL outcomes.
